description: This file defines a base class for email handling, including methods for sending emails, formatting recipient times, and handling errors. It imports various libraries and modules for email processing, configuration, and utility functions.

classes.name: BaseEmail
classes.description: A base class for email operations, providing methods for sending emails, formatting times, and error handling.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone string, defaulting to an empty string.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale string, defaulting to an empty string.

methods.name: getFormattedRecipientTime
methods.description: Formats a given time according to the recipient's timezone and locale.

methods.name: getNodeMailerPayload
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the email payload; default implementation returns an empty object.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Main method to send an email, with checks for feature flags, test mode, and faux email addresses.

methods.name: getMailerOptions
methods.description: Provides mailer configuration options such as transport, from address, and headers.

methods.name: printNodeMailerError
methods.description: Logs email errors unless in E2E testing environment.
